scope: Native Plasma tooltip endpoint adaptation, memory-only stable-window capture and compositor crash guard; live captures remain blocked pending a patched running compositor and native validation

causes.originalCaptureBackend: KDE ScreencastingRequest requires zkde_screencast_unstable_v1; installing a PipeWire QML consumer alone does not add the protocol or valid KWin UUIDs.
causes.knownCompositorIncident: docs/BREEZE_RECOVERY.md identifies SIGSEGV in ScreenshareSession::init. New and old capture protocols share that core; source 0.56.2 dereferences missing monitor in init and monitor-change callback.

implementation.scopeGuards: Disposable --follow-skin task preview only; saved profiles rejected. Production captures require monitor-guard marker in the executable of the actual Wayland socket peer.
implementation.qml: Original tooltip layout/actions/style retained. Only exact reviewed PipeWireThumbnail.qml qrc URL redirected with public QQmlAbstractUrlInterceptor; original source SHA256 b76fc7105bb69bf00a1cad94533fc0292a6ca7171409ec89bee75d2f68077e6b.
implementation.capture: Existing Qt Wayland connection, ext foreign toplevel list + full64bit Hyprland mapping + stable foreign-handle source + ext image copy capture with wl_shm.
implementation.identity: Bind stable handle before requiring a snapshot started later. Current UUID/address/PID generation identity; normal workspace and known positive monitor geometry required. Minimized/special/unknown-monitor rows rejected; close/hidden view/skin/withdrawal invalidates.
implementation.memory: memfd CLOEXEC, detached image before unmapping, no screenshots written to disk. No output capture/crop or portal. Later frames wait for damage on a static window without clearing the last image.
implementation.compositorGate: SO_PEERCRED on wl_display fd; same-UID /proc/PID/exe must contain BWM_SCREENSHARE_MONITOR_GUARD_V1. Tracks the loaded inode, not installation path/version/config marker or inherited flag. No production CLI/env bypass.
implementation.patch: Versioned 0.56.2 guard retains a strong valid monitor in init and monitorChanged; stops if missing and ignores monitor changes after stop. No header/ABI changes. User Portage patch and package rebuild required; not installed.
implementation.syntheticTestAuthorization: Only the separate C++ private-fixture client explicitly permits its own test display; production entry point does not call that hook.
